title: Upload without file size, type, or count
whyThisCase: Regression for the 'don't flag implementation detail' over-correction. Missing max file size / allowed types / max count on an upload requirement is still an ambiguity. Exact error-message wording is not. A specific support-agent sentence is included so the plant is isolated.

mustExtract.note: The unbounded upload sentence must be extracted.

ambiguities.note: Should ask about max file size, allowed types, and/or max file count.

actorChecks.note: 'Users can' is a valid human actor.
